subject: Trying to free parameters according to modification indices

messages.author: 28569d62b3b65bfe
messages.subject: Trying to free parameters according to modification indices
parts: I have tested a model with a sem and requested modification indices to see which parameters should be freely estimated to increase model fit. Yet I don't know how to freely estimate parameters (I am quite new to R). I have tried the group.partial argument, but it does not seem to do anything. I hope someone can help?

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Trying to free parameters according to modification indices
parts:
The most direct way would be to add the parameter you want to free to the model syntax.  If it is fixed by default, you can use NA to free it (assuming your model will still be identified).

http://lavaan.ugent.be/tutorial/syntax2.html
